text:
No option can be put forward yet: the model could not test your “monthly churn under 4% per month” condition.

- Churn is modelled as a calculated change, not a measured monthly rate on the same scale as your limit, so the constraint was excluded rather than scored incorrectly.
- The comparison is also provisional because Non‑Pro MRR had no supplied starting value and defaulted to £0/month; downstream MRR results may therefore be unreliable.
- Active Pro subscribers are the most structurally influential assumption; their source is not recorded. The tested price-to-MRR relationship was also fragile, but that does not establish overall stability.

The current analysis is a model-relative comparison, not a conclusion on whether to raise the price.
